title: Add an AnalyticsEvent.outboxDeadLettered constant instead of reusing LogEvents.sync.outboxDeadLettered for analytics

evidence.quote: // All [AppLogger] call sites MUST use a constant from this file (or from a

why: PV-5 requires every Analytics event to route through an AnalyticsEvent constant so one regex/format check and one searchable catalog cover all analytics traffic. LogEvents is documented (log_events.dart:6) as the AppLogger structured-log catalog, not the analytics one, and AnalyticsEvent (analytics_service.dart) does not list sync_outbox_dead_lettered at all — this analytics event is invisible to anyone auditing 'every analytics event we send' via AnalyticsEvent, and once custom_lint's no_raw_logevent check is un-broken it needs to catch this cross-catalog case, not just raw string literals.
recommendation: Add `static const outboxDeadLettered = 'sync_outbox_dead_lettered';` to AnalyticsEvent and reference that at both call sites instead of LogEvents.sync.outboxDeadLettered.
acceptance_criteria: The PV-5 audit grep (or no_raw_logevent once custom_lint is fixed) confirms every logEvent( call site in this file references AnalyticsEvent.*.

corrections: First evidence entry cites outbox_processor.dart:263 for quote "LogEvents.sync.outboxDeadLettered," but that text is actually at line 264; line 263 is "final future = _analytics?.logEvent(". Second citation (line 369) is exact. Underlying claim still holds.
